title: Session Summaries (part 2)
content:
Session 27 - “The Shoe Inn” 12/19/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Jibjib, Kronk

  • Sending Stone Messages. After leaving Loomlurch, the Party set out atop Little Oak, traveling back toward Nib's Cave. On the way, they received another Sending Stone message from the Ollie Copy they’d messaged previously. He started calling himself “Sir Poem”. Perry responded, trying to set up a meeting with him. Sir Poem said he didn't know how to meet, but told of how he encountered a few more Ollie Copies in his travels.

  • Removing Curses from Kids. The Party realized the kids had regular ol’ curable curses from Skab. So Sig cured most of the kids. Some liked their powers, so they kept their curses.

  • Daterra, the Mycologist. Daterra did another Spore-Scarred deal on herself, becoming much more skilled in everything shrooms!

  • Tripping and Ethereal. On Little Oak,Daterra was still trippin’ balls on Angel Trumpet. She saw ghostly animals and chased a rabbit. Kronk learned his final Ethereal power to see these same ghostly figures, and he helped make sure Daterra didn't run off.

  • Hag Dreams. Bav and Skab kept trying to use their Dream spells on Daterra. Her Amulet did not block these, and (thanks to the DM misspeaking) the hags gave the most horrendous disgusting nightmares ever… and ruined Daterra’s Long Rest. Sig's deity (dee-addy) helped teach him a ritual that could block the hag nightmares by instead giving the most pleasurable good dreams Daterra could imagine.

  • The Shoe Inn. The Party stopped at the Shoe Inn on the way to Nib's Cave. This Inn was literally the size of a shoe, and everyone shrunk as they approached it. Here they met the owner "King" Gennorin, a horned and cursed firbolg. Inside they met the tiefling sisters Brevity "Brev" the barkeep and Symphony "Simmy" the waitress.

  • Shopping. At the Shoe Inn, they did some shopping with some gold, but mostly had to pay with life essence like spell slots and HP. Perry bought some bagpipes, and though he got the gist of how to play them from his skill on the piano, Jib did a little better, and Agdon did best due to his experience with his old friends in the harengon gang. But really everyone learned bagpipes kinda always sound bad.

  • Chef Jimjar of Many Flavors. Daterra helped in the kitchen of the Shoe Inn all day, deceiving almost everyone into thinking she was a famous chef named Jimjar of Many Flavors. She played a mini game successfully, working off her bill. The only person not convinced was a grumpy old redcap.

  • Choux Pastries. Jib and some others tried the choux pastries, learning they were secretly made of souls, blood, and life essence. But they had healing powers and were illusioned to taste amazing.

  • The Secret of the Shoe Inn. Sig and Daterra decided to stay the night at the Shoe Inn, all others heading back to Little Oak. Daterra tripped balls one more time and saw ghosts at the Inn, including a pixie paladin knight who'd stood up against the hags back when they were first taking over. They came and murdered him at the Shoe Inn. He confirmed that the Inn and its owner King Gennorin were cursed by Skab, and the curse can't be lifted while Skab lives. The pixie ghost pleaded with the Party to avenge him and the Inn, saying he can’t pass on until Skab is dead. This pixie was the dead brother of Bealewen, a pixie who King Gennorin loved. A while back, King had asked Skab to teach him her shrinking magic to be with his pixie love. Skab obliged, but shrank everyone including Bealewen, and then cursed the whole Inn.

  • Nib's Cave. Arriving back at Nib's, all was still safe, and the Party finally managed to break Nib's brainwashing. He vowed to stop helping the hags, to make cursed items for them, and to hide some of the rescued kids. Thus Nib's Cave continued to grow into a safe haven. He also gave more great golden items to the Party for rescuing his niece and nephew. Then the Party prepared to depart back into the Underdark.

  • Bonds with Naal. Jib gave Naal her mom's belongings, like Nira's Beast Mask. Jib and Perry now have a deep bond with Naal.

  • Oink/Pignatious Stayed Behind. Daterra reluctantly left the piglet with its original owner, the halfling girl Philomena.

  • Agdon Stayed Behind. Perry had Agdon remain with Little Oak to protect and train the Getaway Gang. Agdon was so honored, and he swore an oath to Perry that the next time they would meet, he would have done enough to earn knighthood. It gave Agdon a new chance and renewed meaning in his life.

  • Which NPCs are Where? Since there've been so many, here's a reminder of where all the recent NPCs are. 

    • With the Party: Shuushar, Shrump, Kle, Zombie Zarak, JJ, Jasper, Snoodle, Banksy, Tueue, Toadst. 

    • At Nib's Cave: Clapperclaw, Wendel, Wren, Yevelda, Philomena, Oink/Pignatious. 

    • With Little Oak: Will, Naal, Vellora, Zennor, Kinruk, Kinlyn, Roff, Pogo, Star the Displacer Kitten.

    • Still captive at Loomlurch: Mishka, Sigh, Puddlemore, Squid, Elkhorn.

  • Fairy Circle back to Underdark. Outside Nib's Cave, the Party met the same fairy circle of campestris they met before. Sig used the circle to Riftwalk, steering the Party toward Gracklstugh, the Underdark capital city of the Gray Dwarves.

  • Zombie Pit. The nearest area of high Faerzress concentration was unfortunately deep under the city in a winding and glowing series of passageways called the Whorlstone Tunnels. The Party plopped out of the Rift right into a pit full of writhing corpses! Some little gnome-like guy was standing over the pit, saw them, squeaked in surprise, and started shooting his crossbow down at them. Sig used Turn Undead and epically burned 2/3 of the whole zombie pit. Perry used his Paladin restrain ability on half the rest and the guy shooting at them. Zombies clawed at the Party as they scrambled to escape, and a zombie hand thing crawled over Kronk's face. Daterra flew up out of the pit with her new Bat Cloak from Nib, but some zombies held on, biting her ankles. Kronk's new Rope of Climbing helped the Party escape the pit.

  • Next Time. They got out of the pit as zombies writhed around unable to follow. The gnome-like guy was restrained and at their mercy. But where were they, who was this guy, and how would they get to the actual dwarven city above?

Current Objectives: 

  • Find your Stolen Things.

  • Find out who framed you for stealing things from Hourglass Coven hag sisters.

  • Find the missing unicorn horn to unfreeze Zybilna in her palace.

  • End the Hags’ tyranny over Prismeer.

  • Solve Bavlorna's Big Book of Bad Blood.

  • Solve the Puzzle Box.

  • Rescue remaining kids from Loomlurch: Mishka, Sigh, Puddlemore, Squid, Elkhorn.

  • Stop the demons pouring into the Underdark from the Abyss.

  • Solve the Ollie copies plot. “Radnelac”, “Smite”, etc.

  • Bring Nib furnishings for his home.

  • Go to Gracklstugh (the capital city of the gray dwarves), Skab wants a captive dragon investigated and preferably freed from the dwarves. 

  • Go to Neverlight Grove (home of the myconids like Shrump), Skab wants Daterra to collect spores or mushrooms from the heart of the grove and bring back to her for her alchemical experiments. 

  • Go to Blingdenstone (Sig's hometown and capital city of the deep gnomes), Skab wants a so-called "king" there investigated in case he is a threat to Skab and others.


Mysteries & Leads: 

  • Rifts between Underdark, Feywild, and Abyss. “Faerzress” and “fairy circles” amplified.

  • Jibjib learned of conspiracies from his Patron. Also warned to return to Underdark asap.

  • Demons are pouring into the Underdark through portals for some reason.

  • Zybilna and/or her Palace staff members have powerful magic items, make magic circles, and know about defeating/trapping demons.


Session 26 - “Stealth and Rescue” 10/21/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Jibjib, Kronk

Before session 27, level up to Level 7!

  • As the sun was setting over Loomlurch, home of Granny Skabatha Nightshade, the Party was still split into two groups.

GROUP 1

  • Combat in the Sewing Room. Perry, Sig, and Jibjib continued combat against the Doll, the Rug, and the Tin Soldier in the Sewing Room. Sig was smothered by the Rug while grappling with the Doll within, nearly killed before Perry and Jib helped defeat them. 

  • Kids Rescued. The Party almost raised the alarm of the entire place many times, but just barely managed to keep up the stealth mission and rescue more kids in the Workshop: Nira and Kelek's halfling-elf daughter Naal, Nib the Miser's human niece Wren, and the little halfling girl Philomena. Also Nib's nephew Wendel and Roff the bugbear girl were safely evacuated from the house.

  • Kle the Elk waited outside to ferry more rescued kids away to the safety of Little Oak in the distance.

  • Sig was still disguised as a Tin Soldier.

  • Jibjib expertly stealthed along the ceilings with Spider Climb.

  • Brainwashed and Marble Visions. Perry used his marbles to see memory visions of Philomena, snapping her out of her brainwash. Naal and Wren were reminded of their family, snapping them out of theirs.

  • Family Portraits. Sig tried to prick Wendel's finger at the Family Portraits, but Wendel noticed and got weirded out. Roff offered to prick her finger for them. This covered their tracks a bit so Skab wouldn't find Sig and his family in the portraits.

  • Kids and Elkhorn Left Behind. Wren rattled off all the names of the kids at Loomlurch and also mentioned another prisoner, an adult named Elkhorn. The stealth group left after rescuing 8 kids total, forced to leave 4 more behind (Pud, Sigh, Mishka, and Squid), along with whoever Elkhorn was.

  • Delivery for Skabatha! Just before leaving, Perry knocked on the door and yelled "Delivery for Skabatha", distracting Skab away from finding Sig in the Tin Soldier Barracks. Perry had intrusive thoughts about standing in the doorway as it opened, but Jib and Sig yelled at him to leave with them. Skab went to the door, opening it only to find a heart carved into the door. Furious, Skab returned to the Parlor.

GROUP 2

  • Teatime in the Parlor. Meanwhile Daterra, Kronk, Shuushar, JJ, and Jasper continued in dealings with Skabatha in the Parlor.

  • No Deal for Kronk. Kronk was not cooperative with Skab, not letting her touch him while talking, and not giving in to any hag deals. Skab was intrigued by how badly Kronk wanted his pocket watch back, so she wanted to know more about it, not believing it was mundane and powerless. She didn't like any deals Kronk suggested, and Kronk stayed strong and didn't do bad deals with her.

  • Mimic Chairs. Daterra and Kronk realized the chairs they were sitting on were actually mimics, which glued them to their seats and threatened to bite if they misbehaved.

  • Fish issue, "fishue" if you will. Shuushar offered his own muscle to Kronk in a deal. Skab made him give up 3 whole points of Strength - 1 given to Kronk, 2 she kept for herself. Skab looked ‘roided up after that, and Kronk was maxed out at 20 Strength! But the muscle given to Kronk was literally Shuushar's flesh, scaly and discolored on Kronk's bicep. Kronk developed a trauma from the repulsive exchange.

  • Separation Anxiety. Daterra had an anxiety attack from Jasper leaving her to go stealthily follow Skab while she made a potion for Shuushar's deal.

  • Leaving Loomlurch. After the Shuushar deal, Skab let the group go free.

BACK AT LITTLE OAK

  • Everyone reconvened and left Loomlurch in a hurry.

  • Comforting Naal. Perry broke the news of her mother's death to Naal, with the help of Jibjib, and gave Nira's items to her. Naal was devastated but stayed tough, resulting in growing bonds between them.

  • Vibin' with Ghost Nira. Daterra whispered with her new Cicada Vial and made a deal for a new ability that let her feel and give Vibes. She used this in conjunction with taking an Angel Trumpet mushroom, and gave everyone a hallucinogenic trip where they saw faint echoes and images of ghosts around them! Daterra called out to Nira Nestfoot, trying to get Nira to be at peace and everyone to forgive one another for her death. Nira fainty responded. Sig, a Grave Cleric, knew this was literally the soul of Nira being contacted in the afterlife. Sig saw that Nira had peacefully passed on to a good afterlife in the Feywild. However, Nira was still deeply troubled about her ex-husband Kelek, who their daughter Naal still trusted and loved. Kronk and Sig were not able to fully let go of the bit of guilt or sadness they had about Nira's death.

  • Contacting Dagon. Jibjib contacted his patron Dagon, asking him how the Demogorgon cult at Sloobludop got started in the first place. Jib risked opening up his mind to eldritch horrors, but got some useful responses.

  • "Two Hags One Nightmare". Bav was furious that Daterra ended their deal and gave the eye to Skab, so she tried to haunt Daterra's dreams that night. Skab intervened in the same dream, shooing away her sister, saying "Daterra is mine". It became clear that both hags would soon become fully hostile enemies trying to ruin Daterra's Long Rest each night.

  • Sig’s 1-on-1 Scene. Sig had a dream scene with Mr. Sixx, where everyone but Mandy left the table. Shh it's a Sigcret.

  • Next time. The Party will continue traveling on the back of the treant Little Oak with many new rescued kids. They plan to head back to Nib's Cave to regroup and plan their next destination...

Current Objectives: 

  • Find your Stolen Things.

  • Find out who framed you for stealing things from Hourglass Coven hag sisters.

  • Find the missing unicorn horn to unfreeze Zybilna in her palace.

  • End the Hags’ tyranny over Prismeer.

  • Return Bavlorna's Big Book of Bad Blood, and all her other stuff from her Cottage?

  • Figure out what to do with Rescued Kids.

  • Stop the demons pouring into the Underdark from the Abyss.

  • Solve the Puzzle Box.

  • Solve the Ollie copies plot. “Radnelac”, “Smite”, etc.

  • Bring Nib furnishings for his home.

  • Go to Gracklstugh (the capital city of the gray dwarves), Skab wants a captive dragon investigated and preferably freed from the dwarves. 

  • Go to Neverlight Grove (home of the myconids like Shrump), Skab wants Daterra to collect spores or mushrooms from the heart of the grove and bring back to her for her alchemical experiments. 

  • Go to Blingdenstone (Sig's hometown and capital city of the deep gnomes), Skab wants a so-called "king" there investigated in case he is a threat to Skab and others.


Mysteries & Leads: 

  • Rifts between Underdark, Feywild, and Abyss. “Faerzress” and “fairy circles” amplified.

  • Jibjib learned of conspiracies from his Patron. Also warned to return to Underdark asap.

  • Demons are pouring into the Underdark through portals for some reason.

  • Bav’s Book seems to have a lot of interesting names in it.

  • Zybilna and/or her Palace staff members have powerful magic items, make magic circles, and know about defeating/trapping demons.


Session 25 - “Dealing with Skab (aka Gaslighting Girlboss Gatekeeping)” 10/17/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Jibjib

  • Teatime with Granny. Chucklehead scheduled a meeting to sit down for tea in the parlor, and Daterra, Shuushar, and JJ finally met Skabatha Nightshade. The hospitable Granny served delicious tea and biscuits while invading their personal space and inspecting them up close. Daterra expertly handled the conversation, avoiding Skab's manipulations and attempts at bad deals.

  • Spores and Cicadas. While talking, Skab collected some of Daterra's spores along with some cicadas crawling on the walls. She put them in corked glass vials.

  • Bav's Eye. Bav's eye trembled fearfully when Skab saw it. Skab was determined to get the eye back, saying Bav should've never given away their "family heirloom".

  • What Skab Wanted. In addition to wanting to retrieve Bav's Eye from Daterra, Skab was also determined to give an item to Daterra that would allow her to gain lots of knowledge from the Party as they travel. She also wanted to help break the deal Bav had over Daterra, replacing it with her own deal.

  • Stealth Mission. Meanwhile Jibjib, Perry, and Sig stealthily infiltrated Skabatha's house. Perry used a Potion of Invisibility and Pass Without Trace. Jibjib used Spider Climb. And Sig was Disguised as a Tin Soldier. Jib and Perry avoided the strange scarecrows and pumpkin patch outside, then climbed up a balcony. And Sig walked right in, convincing other Tin Soldiers that he was one of them.

  • Family Tree Portraits. Sig found moving portraits on a wall among thorny brambles. One was an ancient and terrifying hag. Two more depicted Bavlorna and Skabatha. A fourth showed a skeletal hag wearing a black theatrical contraption resembling a dress. And a fifth showed a beautiful dark-haired woman rather than a hag. While trying to find name plaques or anything to identify the paintings, Sig pricked his finger on a thorn, and suddenly the portraits were replaced with Sig's deceased wife and children.

  • The Tinkerling. Sig encountered one of Skab's many constructs, a cute toy that hopped around on a spring and tried to use Mending on anything that needed fixing. Despite his best efforts, Sig was not able to gain yet another pet.

  • Rescued Kids. Everyone reconvened up at the Textile Mill room, where they met 3 kids working at looms: a gnome boy named Pogo, a dwarf girl Kinlyn, and a goblin girl Yevelda. The kids were drugged and brainwashed to forget who they were and to think they were actually Granny Nightshade's family. In order to break this brainwashing, the Party had to remind them of who they used to be.  When this wasn’t working at first… Sig tried to choke out a kid…

  • Pogo Squigglehelm. The gnome boy had Mage Hand and rogue abilities. Perry was able to use a marble to learn memories of Pogo to help the boy snap out of his brainwashed state. Pogo was the younger brother of Podri Squigglehelm... who Jibjib remembered was Zarak's name before he was mutated by Kelek! They haven't yet let Pogo know that his brother was mutated, killed by the Party, and currently raised as a zombie by Daterra.

  • Kinlyn. The dwarf girl had abilities that affected the environment around her based on her emotional state (omg so sexist wow Jamie). They learned this girl had a brother named Kinruk, who was one of the main kids back at Little Oak.

  • Yevelda. The goblin girl seemed perpetually sleepy, but when Perry woke her, he saw her eyes were Perry Marbles that projected imagery of her thoughts, dreams, and memories. They learned this girl was "Yev", who Dask Mudmaw (Shepherd) asked them to rescue.

  • Kle the Elk Rescued Kids. Perry telepathically talked to Kle, having the elk meet them outside. Perry Misty-Stepped out a window and had Kle take the 3 kids back safely to Little Oak.

  • Boggles. Sig found inky gnome-like creatures called Boggles hiding among boxes in the Textile room. They escaped through portals before anyone could grab them.

  • More Rooms Explored. Jib, Sig, and Perry continued searching for more kids. They passed through storage and cupboard rooms. Then through the Tin Soldier Barracks, where they found little houses where the Tin Soldiers probably slept or recharged when not in use.

  • The Cryo-Bot. Another cute construct was encountered. This toy had a dome on its head with an apple perfectly preserved in stasis. Sig fell for the bait and tried to gain another pet, but was hit by an electric discharge attack. Perry stopped the toy from running off and alerting someone… by brutally ripping the thing's head off with his bare hands and hiding all the evidence in a storage room.

  • The Sewing Room. Jibjib, Perry, and Sig encountered a creepy doll construct who was cruelly bossing around 2 more children, with an animated carpet there to protect the doll. Wendel was a human boy and the nephew of Nib the Miser. Roff was a bugbear girl who turns into plants if she stands still too long. Combat broke out, and Sig used Silence to prevent anything raising the alarm. Jib had the kids hide in the storage rooms. During the fight, Skabatha passed by after working on Daterra's special item. Jib narrowly avoided Skab seeing the fight, closing the door of the sewing room as she passed. 

  • Skabatha's Deal. Meanwhile back in the parlor, Daterra and Skab came to an elaborate agreement:

    • Bav's Eye Removed. Replaced with a mundane wooden eye.

    • Bav's Deal Ended. Daterra was totally freed of Bav's deal.

    • Jasper the Raven. Daterra's "Stolen Thing" was returned to her: Jeremy Jasper, her raven friend/familiar. Jasper had been remade into a mechanical toy by Skab.

    • Travel to the Underdark. Skab required Daterra to travel to 3 important locations in the Underdark. The deal with Skab will only end once this is completed. At Gracklstugh (the capital city of the gray dwarves), Skab wants a captive dragon investigated and preferably freed from the dwarves. At Neverlight Grove (home of the myconids like Shrump), Skab wants Daterra to collect spores or mushrooms from the heart of the grove and bring them back to her for her alchemical experiments. At Blingdenstone (Sig's hometown and capital city of the deep gnomes), Skab wants a so-called "king" there investigated in case he is a threat to Skab and others.

    • Spore-Scarred. Skab informed Daterra of a deadly demonic infection her spores have carried throughout the campaign. Any time a PC had been KO'd and "taken a scar", the demon spores infected their open wound. Skab dubbed the Party "The Spore-Scarred". She believed Daterra's druidic magic stabilized these infections, but if people didn't stay close enough to Daterra, their infections might kill them. Skab didn't know how to cure them, but using hag magic, she made an item that could harness the demonic powers of the spores and grant the Party powers.

    • Cordyceps Cicada. Skab gave Daterra a vial containing a cicada infected with the demonic spores and enchanted with hag magic. Skab taught her how to use this new item: It's a spellcasting focus, but also a living organism that whispers ideas for hag-like deals Daterra can give to herself and other PCs. Once a deal is made, the spores meld with one of that person's Scars, and the PC gains a new ability. When using that ability, Daterra expends and rolls one of her Hit Dice for the day, and the roll may affect the results. If Daterra does not either make a new deal or roll a Hit Die at least once per day, she takes Exhaustion.

  • Next time. As the sun is setting for the day, Dattera, Kronk, Shuushar, JJ, and Jasper are all in the Parlor finishing up dealings with Skab. Meanwhile Jibjib, Perry, and Sig are in the Sewing Room fighting the Doll, Rug, and Tin Soldier. Kle the Elk waits outside the window to help rescue more kids, like Wendel and Roff who are currently hiding in a storage room...

Current Objectives: 

  • Find your Stolen Things.

  • Find out who framed you for stealing things from Hourglass Coven hag sisters.

  • Find the missing unicorn horn to unfreeze Zybilna in her palace.

  • End the Hags’ tyranny over Prismeer.

  • Return Bavlorna's Big Book of Bad Blood, and all her other stuff from her Cottage?

  • Rescue kids from Loomlurch: Nira Nestfoot’s daughter Naal, Nib Blackfyre’s niece and nephew Wendel and Wren, Dask’s adoptive daughter Yevelda, and others.

  • Stop the demons pouring into the Underdark from the Abyss.

  • Solve the Puzzle Box.

  • Solve the Ollie copies plot. “Radnelac”, “Smite”, etc.

  • Bring Nib furnishings for his home.

  • Go to Gracklstugh (the capital city of the gray dwarves), Skab wants a captive dragon investigated and preferably freed from the dwarves. 

  • Go to Neverlight Grove (home of the myconids like Shrump), Skab wants Daterra to collect spores or mushrooms from the heart of the grove and bring back to her for her alchemical experiments. 

  • Go to Blingdenstone (Sig's hometown and capital city of the deep gnomes), Skab wants a so-called "king" there investigated in case he is a threat to Skab and others.


Mysteries & Leads: 

  • Rifts between Underdark, Feywild, and Abyss. “Faerzress” and “fairy circles” amplified.

  • Jibjib learned of conspiracies from his Patron. Also warned to return to Underdark asap.

  • Demons are pouring into the Underdark through portals for some reason.

  • Bav’s Book seems to have a lot of interesting names in it.

  • Zybilna and/or her Palace staff members have powerful magic items, make magic circles, and know about defeating/trapping demons.


Session 24 - “Loomlurch” 9/12/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Jibjib

  • Goblin Market. Approaching Loomlurch, home of Granny Skabath Nightshade, the Party noticed tents and stalls with lively goblins sitting around a little campfire late into the night. Perry remembered this traveling goblin market from his childhood, having nostalgic memories of the tasty treats they sold. 

  • Chucklehead. The Party went to the market, meeting the goblin boss Chucklehead, who was cursed with a candied apple head. He had a worm eating his head from the inside and had less than 30 days to live. 

  • Candy and Waffles. The Party bought treats from the market – candies and waffles made of bugs. The treats were gross yet delicious and gave random magical effects. They bought a bunch to take back and share with the Getaway Gang kids. 

  • Sig Shrunk. Sig's waffles made him shrink down to half his size, which made Banksy the cat look at him like a lion stalking its prey. Sig managed to handle the cat and started riding it around on his own little solo adventure, peering through the kitchen window nearby.

  • Perry the Butterfly. Perry's waffles made him polymorph into a black butterfly. Just like Sig, he flew off on his own solo mission, scouting around the entire outside of Loomlurch and uncovering all the fog of war from the map.

  • Dead Goblin. While at the market, one of the goblins randomly keeled over dead. No big deal.

  • Tin Soldier Fight. The Party stealthed around the outside of Loomlurch in the night. They were spotted by a Tin Soldier guarding a door. It was an easy fight, but the little metal construct almost raised its alarm. Inside the Tin Soldier's destroyed body they found a little bell it could've used to emit a magically amplified alarm and a little gold ball that would've allowed it to use the Polymorph spell.  

  • Red Rockets. Near the Tin Soldier they fought was a circle of red mushrooms that at first appeared to be a fairy circle portal. Jibjib simply could not handle how much they resembled... dog penises? On closer inspection, the mushrooms were in fact the tops of red hats on gnome-like creatures beneath the soil. The fight against the Tin Soldier was alerting these gnomish creatures, and they began to rise. The Party was split on whether to leave before the creatures fully emerged and possibly attacked them, or whether to stay and see what the creatures were. Players did a roll-off, which decided that they would leave the area safely. And since they rolled so well it was established that Perry and Jibjib now have a Bond where they can share Inspiration dice. 

  • Rest at Little Oak. Before doing any more, the Party returned to Little Oak to long rest until morning. The kids loved the goblin candies. 

  • Curing Chucklehead. Returning to the goblin market in the morning, Sig used Remove Curse to cure Chucklehead of his apple-head worm curse. Chucklehead seemed like he could be a trustworthy yet bad-influence guardian for a tiefling child named Mishka if they can rescue her. 

  • The Barghest. But while curing Chucklehead, one of the goblins revealed its true nature and attacked! A barghest had been disguising itself as one of the goblins and slowly trying to kill them off. Barghests were wolf-like fiends from the plane Gehenna that wanted to devour the souls of goblinoids. The Party, with the help of the goblins' spells, killed the barghest with little difficulty. 

  • Nilbogs. After the fight, it was revealed that the barghest had been using healing potions to poison the goblins, managing to kill one of them last night. These goblins were in fact "nilbogs", trickster fey goblins that are only harmed by healing magic.  

  • Pigs and Goats. Near the gardens were animal pens with pigs and goats. Daterra used Speak with Animals and found out they were just normal farm animals. Daterra freed them, some of the pigs wrecking part of Skab's garden before leaving. A little piglet named Oink was with the pigs, so of course Daterra gained yet another pet. The pigs said the piglet's owner was someone named Phil or Philbert or something – they had trouble pronouncing the name. Daterra renamed the piglet Pignacious and took it back to Little Oak.

  • The Gardens. Sig disguised himself as a Tin Soldier and distracted one of the real Tin Soldiers on guard nearby. Sig noticed the gardens were filled with skeletons and bones, and as a Grave Cleric, Sig knew these could easily be raised by the hag if she wanted. Meanwhile, Daterra Wild Shaped into a cat and snooped around the gardens, spotting several types of special mushrooms. She stole one of the mushrooms before leaving. 

  • Ticking Heartbeat. Daterra kept noticing the mechanical ticking feeling of her Stolen Thing getting stronger the closer they got to the back of Loomlurch. 

  • The Plan. We ended with some planning for next time. It was around mid day, no alarms had gone off and no one had noticed anything they killed or the animals they freed yet. Skabatha would probably be furious about her animals getting let free, pigs eating some of her garden, a Tin Soldier getting killed, a mushroom getting stolen, and trespassing. Chucklehead said he can go in and request Skabatha have a sit-down in the Parlor with Daterra and Kronk only. Chucklehead gave Perry a bag of "treasures" (candies) to use in bargaining. Meanwhile the rest of the Party could split off and stealth into the house to rescue children and find any Stolen Things. Kle the elk could ferry any kids they get out back to Little Oak, which sits waiting at a safe distance…

Session 23 - “Travel by Tree Continues” 8/22/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib

  • Detect thoughts on Zarak. After defeating the assassin gnome Zarak, Jibjib used Detect Thoughts on him to learn who he was and what he knew. Jibjib pushed his luck, risking Madness to learn as much as possible.

  • Argue over Zarak. The Party had a heated debate over what to do with Zarak. Some wanted to just finish him off. Daterra fed him a mushroom, and it sprouted more from his face. So she wanted to keep him around as her own walking garden. Kronk and Perry argued how morally dark this was.

  • Agdon kills Zarak. Perry nodded discretely to Agdon, telling the squire to kill Zarak, and before anyone could react, the deed was done.

  • Zombie Zarak. Daterra raised Zarak's body from the dead and made him into a Last of Us-style zombie, still attempting to grow mushrooms with his body.

  • Loot. The Party got some really good loot from Zarak, including his mask, bow, poisons, and potions. And Daterra took a skull from one of the construct knights, carving a middle finger in it to give to Bav later.

  • 3 more days of travel. Departing again on Little Oak, the Party headed for Loomlurch to confront Skabatha.

  • Daterra encounters Lornling and Copies. While traveling, Daterra had the option to trigger a solo scene only if she wanted to risk it. Of course she did. So while off on her own foraging for mushrooms, she spotted 2 figures holding up a Lornling that had come for payment from her. When Bav's eye saw these figures - more of the elf Copies like Radnelac - she started blasting them with curse spells. One Copy used his sword to open up a Rift in the planes to escape but was ripped apart by a spell before he could flee. The two wounded elves spliced into each other, one dying as its body parts became slashes of black void and corruption on the other elf.

  • Sending Stones. Before the remaining corrupted elf Copy fell through the Rift, Daterra tossed a Sending Stone to him. Then every day after, Daterra and Perry sent messages back and forth with the elf. It was very interested in how they knew Kronk, and it kept insisting they prove Kronk's strength and trustworthiness.

  • Puzzle and Names. After the encounter with the elf Copies, and after messing with the puzzle box, the Party solved quite a lot. They figured out 7 of the 8 symbols on the puzzle box, which were tied to names of powerful beings like Zybilna and Dagon. Perry's marbles moved around and glowed as if waiting to do something else too. Then the Party also figured out that the elf Copies were in fact copies of Kronk's old friend Ollie, and that their names were anagrams for words like "time" and "calendar".

  • Musical Mushrooms. While traveling on Little Oak, the kids wanted to play a game of Musical Mushrooms. Kinruk the dwarf boy showed off his skillz on the lute, playing music for the game. Zen the orc girl won the first game, and Jibjib won the second.

  • Kinky Sig. Our pervy old man Sig may or may not have had a thing for choking and handcuffs. And his dreams within Mr. Six's night club oddly seemed to encourage this.

  • Kronk Jedi Training. Also while traveling, Shuushar urged Kronk to continue to practice his new Ethereal powers. Kronk learned the ability to contact things through the Ethereal plane, and with it he felt Ollie somewhere out there calling to him. But without Kronk's Pocket Watch, Ollie seemed unreachable.

  • Agdon interrogated by kids. Also while traveling, the Getaway Gang kids were still untrusting of Agdon the notorious brigand. Agdon admitted that the hags had hired thugs like him to put down dissenters, capturing anyone who resisted the Hourglass Coven's rule. He revealed how anyone who stood up to the hags ended up imprisoned or dead, which quickly made everyone else fall in line. But Agdon insisted he knew little of what the hags were doing to those he captured for them. And when Perry and Kronk stood up for Agdon, the kids dropped the interrogating.

  • Planning with Will. Getting closer to Loomlurch, the Party gathered everything they knew about Skab, Loomlurch, etc from Will and their own notes. The Party planned to recon invisibly around Loomlurch, maybe isolating a Tin Soldier to see how easy they are to kill and learn how they communicate with Skab and other Tin Soldiers. The Party also considered the possibility of just going in and sitting with Skab to make a deal like they had with Bav in the past.

  • Approaching Loomlurch. Getting closer, Kronk and Daterra began feeling a mechanical ticking in the air and in their hearts. They knew their Stolen Things were in this area. With Little Oak parked at a safe distance overlooking Loomlurch, the Party saw the bustling movement of many inhabitants of the great fallen tree that Skabatha made into her home. A market along the right side of the building, gardens along the left, and root-bridges leading up the middle to the entrance of Skab’s home.

  • Azaelith's Fate? After the session, it was officially established what had happened to Azaelith. The last session that we saw the kobold was back when the Party had rested overnight at Bav's Cottage. Radnelac the Ollie-Copy had been with the Party overnight, and he had warned that he would be "jumping" again soon. Azaelith, always hasty to charge right into danger, decided to jump into the Rift Radnelac fell through that night, following the elf, hoping to find out where these Copies go. Before anyone could react, Azaelith and Radnelac were gone. The rest of the Party had no way to follow, so they had no choice but to carry on without them. Azaelith is probably fine…

Session 22 - “Ambush at Wayward Pool” 7/25/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib

  • Summoning Lamorna the unicorn. On the Wayward Pool island, Jibjib lit the coals in the brazier. This summoned Lamorna the thicc unicorn. The Party learned she was a ghost. The hags had captured her mate Elidon, and Lamorna died trying to defend him. She destroyed her body in flames so the hags couldn't use her horn for evil. The Party learned from her that Elidon was still alive because she would've sensed if he died and she’d have passed on with him. He was still held prisoner by the hags somewhere, but his horn was missing somewhere else. Lamorna also told of the League of Malevolence, a group of fey led by Kelek who were working for the Unseelie Court, not the hags. They were the ones seeking the horn and anyone they thought might've known about it. Kelek, Zargash the satyr, and the candle Knight Lights were all part of this Unseelie group.

  • Sneaky Sig. Lamorna wasn't sure if she could trust the Party since they were all arguing over secrets Sig was holding out on.

  • Ambush! Suddenly the conversation was interrupted by an arrow shot in Daterra's back!

  • Coal charms. At the last second, Lamorna gave the Party her last gift to the world: the coals in the brazier were charms made from her remains, her abilities and spells divided up into a deck of cards the players could draw from.

  • Combat. The Party was ambushed from the shoreline they came from before crossing the water to the island. An invisible Rogue archer sniped at them continuously from the trees. And with him were two Unseelie Knights similar to others made by Kelek, tree creatures holding human skulls, which later turned out to possibly have been real people transformed into construct abominations by Kelek.

  • Perry the tank. Perry and Daterra were pin cushioned with arrows, Perry charged over to fight the attackers head-on with only the NPCs, and poison claws and arrows knocked Shuushar and Agdon unconscious for most of the fight. Meanwhile the rest of the PCs took Lamorna's coal-charms.

  • Very close fight. It was the closest fight we've had so far, with tactical stealthy combat, a complex map full of hiding spots and terrain features, Perry and Jibjib earning scars from nearly dying, other PCs nearly downed, and Shuushar and Agdon almost lost.

  • Ghost Kronk. Kronk succeeded in testing out one of his new dream-powers, disappearing into the Ethereal realm and drifting around as a ghost invisible to everyone else.

  • Invisible assassin. Everyone struggled in a game of battleship against the invisible archer, using Call Lightnings, Moonbeams, and endless Perception checks to close in on the elusive assassin. Sig managed to get in close, only to be choked and grappled by him.

  • Hunted by Knight. Toward the end, cut off from the others, Jibjib lay unconscious from poison while Daterra desperately hid and stealthed from one of the deadly Knights hunting her. Out of options, one bad roll away from a deadly outcome for both of them, Daterra tossed a rock at Jibjib to wake him up, and Jib took one final shot at the Knight, blasting him with fire for the kill!

  • Elusive assassin. Meanwhile the invisible archer continued to evade the rest of the Party, sniping, running, and attempting to swim away.

  • Kronk from the top rope! But dropping back in from the Ethereal plane straight down into the water with a badass downward slash of his sword, Kronk finally forced the assassin to surrender! Kronk dragged him to the shoreline and shook all his weapons and items out.

  • Zarak the gnome. The assassin finally became visible, revealing a gnomish creature named Zarak, another member of Kelek's Unseelie-backed League of Malevolence, similar to Zargash the satyr the Party had killed earlier in the campaign.

  • So why the ambush? Zarak had been instructed to check out the Wayward Pool for the rumored unicorn living there, but he was unable to figure out how to get past the wards preventing non-unicorns from reaching the island. When the massive noisy treant-treehouse Little Oak came lumbering toward the island, Zarak took a Potion of Greater Invisibility and kept his distance, watching the Party approach and barely avoiding Jibjib's Wand of Enemy Detection. Zarak watched the Party use disguises to get onto the island, and he noticed the wards on the island deactivate as the Party summoned and conversed with Lamorna the unicorn. Then Zarak ambushed, hoping to kill these meddlers and capture the unicorn for his masters, not understanding it was only a ghost.

  • In the end, both Knights were killed, and the Party had Zarak at their mercy with 5hp. Jibjib wanted to Detect Thoughts on the assassin before letting Daterra finish him off...
